definition_zh: 被剥夺的；丧失的；痛失亲人的；茫然若失的
definition_en: deprived of or lacking something valued, or sadly left alone by loss
core_image: 紧攥着的双手摊开，掌心空空，望向远方
scene: 儿子离家后，她整日站在空荡荡的房间里。After her son left, she stood lonely and bereft in the empty house.
sceneCN: 这里 bereft 是「茫然若失的、孤独无依的」（第 2 个义项：因丧失而神情空落）；句意是儿子走后她在空房子里孤独怅惘。

pos.zh: 被剥夺的；丧失的；怅然若失的
bereave 的过去式与过去分词

senses.title: Deprived of something valued
senses.definition: lacking something one needs or treasures, usually with of
senses.definitionCN: 缺少或失去了需要或珍视之物，常与 of 连用
senses.example: The refugees were bereft of home, money, and papers.
senses.exampleCN: 难民们失去了家园、钱财和证件。
senses.why: It is the participle of bereave, a violent taking away.
senses.whyCN: 它是 bereave（强行夺走）的分词形式，保留了被夺走的意味。

senses.title: Grieving and forlorn after loss
senses.titleCN: 怅然若失的；哀伤孤独的
senses.definition: looking or feeling sadly empty because of a loss
senses.definitionCN: 因丧失而神情空落、孤寂哀伤
senses.example: After her son left, she stood lonely and bereft in the empty house.
senses.exampleCN: 儿子走后，她在空房子里孤独怅惘地站着。
senses.why: Being robbed of a loved one leaves an empty, lost look.
senses.whyCN: 被夺走所爱之人后，脸上便留下空茫失落。

intro.en: Bereft is the irregular past participle of bereave, from Old English bereafian.
intro.cn: bereft 是 bereave 的不规则过去分词，源自古英语 bereafian。

items.en: the root reup- or reub- meant to snatch, to plunder.
items.cn: 词根 reup- 或 reub- 意为「抢夺」（重构形式）。

items.en: bereafian meant to plunder; bereaft was its participle.
items.cn: 古英语 bereafian 意为「掠夺」，bereaft 是其分词形式。

items.en: berefte served as past and participle alongside bereaved.
items.cn: 中古英语 berefte 与 bereaved 并存，作过去式和分词。

items.en: bereft became standard for the participle and grew adjective uses.
items.cn: 十七世纪 bereft 成为标准分词形式，并发展出形容词用法。

items.en: it now lives mostly as an adjective of loss and emptiness.
items.cn: 如今主要作为表示丧失与空落的形容词使用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the re- root family or spelling; the near-meaning group gathers loss and emptiness words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 re- 词族或拼写；近义组汇集丧失与空落类词。

entries.definition: to deprive of a loved one

entries.definitionCN: leave 的过去式——拼写相近，词源无关
匮乏的；侧重物质或机会

entries.definition: barren or made miserable by loss

normalIntro.en: Bereft is the participle of bereave, fixed as an adjective.
normalIntro.cn: bereft 是 bereave 的分词，固化为形容词。

normal.en: It usually takes the phrase bereft of.
normal.cn: 常与 of 搭配，作 bereft of。
bereft of hope 指失去希望。

normal.en: It can describe a lost, empty face.
normal.cn: 它也可形容空茫失落的神情。

abstract.en: See open palms with nothing left to hold.
abstract.cn: 看摊开却无物可握的掌心。

abstract.en: Feel an empty coat sleeve in the wind.
Picture a bird returned to a bare branch.
abstract.cn: 想象小鸟归落只剩枯枝。

examples.en: After her son left, she stood lonely and bereft in the empty house.
examples.cn: 儿子走后，她在空房子里孤独怅惘地站着。

examples.en: The refugees were bereft of home, money, and papers.
examples.cn: 难民们失去了家园、钱财和证件。

examples.en: He was bereft of words at the funeral.
examples.cn: 葬礼上他一句话也说不出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必·离佛」——连佛都离他而去，两手空空、怅然若失。

root: bereave 的不规则过去分词；前缀 re-（表「夺离」，与 rob、rip 同出原始印欧语词根 reup- 或 reub-「抢夺」，属重构形式）加古英语 -reafian「掠夺」，分词 bereaft 经中古英语 berefte 沿用至今，并固化为形容词。

sensesIntro.en: One participle-remeasuring loss, from stripped belongings to an emptied heart.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个分词，量度丧失——从被夺走的财物到被掏空的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: open palms with nothing left to hold.
core.cn: 核心意象：摊开却无物可握的掌心。

intro.en: Bereft freezes the snatching participle bereaft into daily description.
intro.cn: bereft 把表抢夺的分词 bereaft 凝固成日常形容词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is Germanic throughout.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，全词为日耳曼语源。
